name: S-GRADES
description: S-GRADES is a web-based benchmark consolidating 14 diverse student response grading datasets under a unified interface with standardized evaluation protocols. It supports both essay and short-answer grading tasks, enabling evaluation of generalization and reliability of models across diverse educational NLP settings.
reputation: A newer benchmark that aggregates multiple student-answer grading datasets and is gaining attention in educational NLP, but it is not yet a long-established standard leaderboard.
notes: Consolidates multiple datasets with standardized protocols; supports extensibility and continuous integration.
